name: NEODRIVE
description:
About This Game

NEODRIVE is an arcade time-attack game about living on the edge of control. Learn the unique handling of each car across a 60+ track campaign. Master the viscerally rewarding manual transmission, challenge your friends' ghosts and get the perfect run in a race without loading screens.

 

Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master

Learn the handling model in the early stages and then push it to its limits. Execute technical drifts and jumps on fantastical tracks. For absolute control and faster nitro buildup, use the optional manual shifting featuring a one-button clutch. Use the audio and haptic feedback to manage your RPM, as money-shifting or under-revving will stall your engine. Shift cleanly, though, and you’ll fill your boost meter more quickly and rocket past your previous ghost and up the leaderboard.

Time-Attack Progression

Race against yourself or others' ghosts to shave milliseconds off your personal records and unlock achievements. Every track contains four tiers of medals: Bronze, Silver, and Gold, alongside a concealed Author Medal if you want to challenge the developer.

Ascend Across Stages

Prove your driving skills across a full 64-track campaign divided into four escalating difficulty classes. In each difficulty stage, explore each new row of tracks by gaining medals on the previous four.

Beat Your Friends (And Yourself)

Integrated Steam leaderboards let you see your friends’ ghosts, or make your mark on the global leaderboards for all to see. As long as you hit every checkpoint and finish, any and every route counts.
short_desc: NEODRIVE is an arcade racing game about pushing fantastical vehicles to their limits. Master an optional manual transmission and deep yet arcadey racing mechanics as you unlock more of the 60+ track campaign and make your mark on the global leaderboards.
